title: ci(glue): narrow the Merge Queue Triage and Scheduled Full Run Card workflow_run triggers by branch
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbSEPKA2THqjdJg8Yufat646)_

Fixes #31521

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:两个 `workflow_run` 胶水 workflow 的触发器各加一行 `branches:`。`merge-queue-triage.yml` 只在 `gh-readonly-queue/**` 上的 CI 跑完时触发,`scheduled-full-run-card.yml` 只在 `main` 上的被监视 workflow 跑完时触发。两个 job 的 `if:` 一字未动,仍是唯一裁决。
- **为什么改**:以前每次 CI(以及 Lint、UI Coverage)跑完都会各起一个 run,随后被 job `if:` 跳过,把 Actions 列表淹掉。按 11-01..07 的 7 天均值:Merge Queue Triage 757 → 263/天(−65%),Scheduled Full Run Card 1,512 → 269/天(−82%)。真正干活的次数不变(队列红约 18 次/天;卡片只看 schedule 红)。
- **风险与回滚**:唯一风险是 GitHub 的分支匹配对 merge_group 触发的 run 不按 `head_branch`(`gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-…`)匹配,那样队列红就没人写 triage 评论。这一点 PR 上测不到(`workflow_run` 只从默认分支跑)。回滚 = 删掉对应那一行 `branches:`。
- **先看**:`.github/workflows/merge-queue-triage.yml` 的触发块(风险全在这一行);`.github/workflows/scheduled-full-run-card.yml` 的触发块。
- **两分钟验证**:合并后第一个红的 merge_group CI 跑完,打开 Actions → Merge Queue Triage,应看到对应的 run 且该 PR 上出现 triage 评论;平时该列表里只剩 merge_group 对应的 run。
- **需要你做的**:这是 `.github/workflows/**` 受管面(Tier H),请你亲手合并。

## What changes

- `.github/workflows/merge-queue-triage.yml`: `on.workflow_run` gains `branches: ['gh-readonly-queue/**']`, with a comment saying why and that the job `if:` (`event == 'merge_group' && conclusion == 'failure'`) stays the authority.
- `.github/workflows/scheduled-full-run-card.yml`: `on.workflow_run` gains `branches: [main]`, with a comment saying the same. The job `if:` keeps all three guards, its own `head_branch == 'main'` included.
- Nothing else changes. No script, no job body, no permission, no concurrency group. `fleet-write.yml` and every relay sender are untouched. The relay's fold half (Wanted 1) is `domain:skills`' and is filed by the seat from the sender table on the card (comment 6722165466).

GitHub's `workflow_run` trigger can filter on `workflows`, `types` and `branches`/`branches-ignore`. It cannot filter on the triggering run's event or conclusion. So the runs that remain are the ones whose event the trigger cannot see: green merge_group runs for triage, and `push` runs on `main` for the card. They still land as skipped jobs, as today.

## Tests

Local, at head `a8dfeaf0` (after merging `origin/main`). The derived set came from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, which gave 38 commands, all 38 exit 0. The derivation is identical before and after the merge, and the merge brought no `scripts/` or `.github/` path.

<details><summary>Gate readings</summary>

- `node scripts/check-merge-queue-triage-outcome.mjs`: exit 0, `OK (141 assertions over 35 scenarios, driving the 41766-char script extracted from .github/workflows/merge-queue-triage.yml against real captured logs)`. Its `--self-test` also exits 0.
- `node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, `self-test OK`. This one is outside the derivation and was run because it is the card workflow's own self-test. It reads the single-line `workflows:` list, the concurrency group and the crons; `branches:` sits on its own line.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`: exit 0, `✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 2205 cases pass`, run at `9f3b9f1a` (the merge after it touched no `scripts/` or `.github/` path).
- The other 35 derived commands each exited 0, among them `check:workflow-status-functions`, `check:workflow-step-name-quoting`, `check:required-contexts`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-expected-skips`, `check-self-test-wired` and `check-step-collectors`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: exit 0, `38 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- YAML parse of both files: `on.workflow_run` reads `{"workflows":["CI"],"types":["completed"],"branches":["gh-readonly-queue/**"]}` and `{"workflows":["CI","Lint & Type Check","UI Coverage"],"types":["completed"],"branches":["main"]}`. The job `if:` strings are byte-unchanged.

</details>

No ablation: the diff is workflow configuration and changes no tested behaviour.

## Acceptance notes

- **Post-landing check, owned by the seat.** Whether GitHub's branch matcher reads a merge_group-triggered run's `head_branch` is **NOT MEASURED**: a `workflow_run` workflow only runs from the default branch, so no PR can show it. The docs say the filter names "what branches the triggering workflow must run on", and on 2026-11-07 all 181 merge_group CI runs had `head_branch` `gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-…`, while no run of any other event did. **The first red merge_group CI build after merge must still get its Merge Queue Triage run and comment, or the seat reverts the `merge-queue-triage.yml` line.**
- Runs per day, before → predicted after (UTC days 2026-11-01..07, 6-hour `created=` windows, because a day query caps `total_count` at 2,500):

  | workflow | before (mean/day) | after (predicted) | basis |
  |---|---:|---:|---|
  | Fleet Write | 3,383 | 3,383 | unchanged here; fold half filed to `domain:skills` |
  | Merge Queue Triage | 757 | 263 | merge_group CI runs, 1,840 for the week |
  | Scheduled Full Run Card | 1,512 | 269 | CI on `main` 939 + Lint on `main` 939 + UI Coverage 7, for the week |

- The card's Acceptance asks for after-counts on the card. The seat reads them once a full UTC day has passed since landing.

## Verification

```
git diff origin/main...HEAD -- .github/workflows/
```

That shows two hunks, each a comment block plus one `branches:` line under `types: [completed]`.
